method.totals: Sum complete returned daily property rows. Both windows return 28 distinct dates and hasMore=false.
method.position: sum(position * impressions) / sum(impressions), approximate because the connector returns rounded positions. Zero-impression dates contribute no weight.
method.connectorLimit: Dimensionless queries are rejected by connector validation. Daily totals reconcile with current device and country totals.
method.queryCoverage: Current query rows expose 24 impressions and no clicks, so they cannot identify the recorded click query.
method.pageAggregation: Current page rows sum to 124 page-level impressions. Do not substitute this for the 70 property-level impressions.
